name: Man Wreck
source:
An imp wants to be promoted into an incubus. He needs to undergo a test: turning a town of men into willing subjects of Hell. This means there are obstacles to clear, and there are a lot of seduction/tricks to be played. An adult visual novel that explores many heavy kinks in gay fantasies, this game faces taboos head on. A simple puzzle system provides some casual fun in between story progressions.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1171640/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一只小恶魔想要晋升为男魅魔。他必须接受一项考验：让一整座城镇的男人心甘情愿地臣服于地狱。这意味着他要排除重重阻碍，施展各种诱惑与诡计。这部成人视觉小说直面禁忌，探索男同性恋幻想中的多种重口味性癖。简单的解谜系统，则为剧情推进的间隙增添了一些轻松的乐趣。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1171640/]Steam[/url]]
